summary: Frontend-only verification of the Xaluca logo overlay change on the home page. All 6 required home-page sections render the Xaluca logo badge in the top-right of their card/poster images with the correct data-testid prefixes, all logos are visible, and the regression contract on the 'home-all-trips' catalog section holds (no new logo badge added; monogram-X overlays preserved). Top contact bar and home page render cleanly with no console errors.

verification_details.top-info-bar: Present at top with '+34 937 268 366' and 'Lunes a viernes de 10:00 a 20:00 h'
verification_details.our-trips: 6/6 logos present and visible (our-trips-logo-full, -south, -north, -short, -adventure, -bespoke). Featured big card uses larger 56x56 badge, small cards 44x44. All positioned top-right.
verification_details.all-trips-carousel: 21 all-trips-logo-* badges rendered; first 5 visible (rest off-screen in scrollable track). Sample testid: all-trips-logo-ad-4-5.
verification_details.category-carousels: All 5 carousels present (home-south-, home-full-, home-short-, home-north-, home-upcoming-carousel). Each contains 5–6 home-trip-logo-* badges, 3 visible per carousel (rest in horizontal scroll). Visible.
verification_details.feel-section: feel-logo-experiences, feel-logo-accommodations, feel-logo-connection all present & visible.
verification_details.morocco-videos: 6 video-logo-* badges present and visible on poster cards (sample: video-logo-k8FtwzRCo3M).
verification_details.circuits-section: circuit-logo-sahara visible on active detail image (only the active circuit renders a badge as expected from active state).
verification_details.REGRESSION home-all-trips: 0 new home-trip-logo-* badges inside data-testid='home-all-trips' (correct). 40 home-all-trips-monogram-* overlays still present (sample: home-all-trips-monogram-tourAtlasDesierto45).
verification_details.console: Only benign 'Unrecognized feature: web-share' warning. No JS errors. No broken layout.

critical_code_review_comments: XalucaLogoBadge component is clean, reusable, decorative (aria-hidden, pointer-events-none) — good a11y choice for a brand watermark.
Minor: the AllTripsCarousel renders 21 logos at once (all cards); fine for now but watch for image bandwidth — they share the same .webp asset so browser caches it (single network request).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Logo overlay feature fully verified at viewport 1440x900 on https://morocco-trips-2.preview.emergentagent.com/. All testids defined in review_request resolved as expected. Regression on home-all-trips monogram intact. No follow-up needed.
